projectDescription: A climate-smart AI tool for rice farmers that predicts life-cycle assessment (LCA) impacts of fertiliser applications, estimates field emissions, calculates soil-carbon credit potential, and generates multilingual agronomic inference cards.
keyFeatures: ML-powered LCA impact prediction for conventional (NPK+Zn) and organic (FYM+Compost) fertiliser regimes
Field-level GHG emission estimation (CH₄, N₂O, NO₃, NH₃, PO₄) using IPCC + SALCA factors
Conventional / organic fertiliser blend optimisation with per-hectare INR cost comparison
Soil organic carbon (SOC) credit estimator aligned to India's CCTS price band (₹600–₹900/t)
Multilingual agronomic inference cards (English, Hindi, Telugu, Marathi) with actionable recommendations
Metadata endpoint exposing input ranges, cost rates, and citation registry
FastAPI REST backend deployable via Docker on Render or any container platform
Integrated static frontend (dashboard + landing page) served by the same FastAPI process
